issuing_body: AI Safety Institute (J-AISI / AI セーフティ・インスティテュート)
covered_actors: Development and provision managers (開発・提供管理者)
AI users (AI 利用者, optional reference)
Third-party evaluation organizations (サードパーティ評価実施組織)
implementation_notes: Non-binding technical evaluation guide (Ver. 1.20, revised July 7, 2026) maintained as a Living Document by Japan's AI Safety Institute (J-AISI) in alignment with the METI/MIC AI Guidelines for Business (Ver. 1.2). Primarily scopes LLM systems, multimodal foundation models (added in the March 28, 2025 revision), and LLM-based AI agent systems (newly expanded in Ver. 1.20 with added evaluation perspectives for observation and control of autonomous behavior and external environment interactions). Intended as a voluntary reference for technical and management-level AI safety evaluations rather than a legally binding mandate.
